scope: FCIS M6 outbox enqueue, lease, destination, acknowledgment, recovery, and migration boundaries

scenarios.trigger: A worker attempts delivery before the publication transaction commits the outbox row.
preconditions: the candidate effect is not a member of a committed canonical outbox
the worker has no committed effect witness
scenarios.fault_boundary: before publication COMMIT and before destination send
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no network send or production worker is proven

scenarios.trigger: A durable layout contains an outbox row without its complete publication ancestry.
preconditions: outbox effect ancestry is incomplete or crossed
canonical reopen is required before any state change
scenarios.fault_boundary: reopen after an incomplete or surplus row family
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no power-loss datastore theorem is claimed

scenarios.trigger: A retry reuses an effect ID while presenting a different payload root.
preconditions: the destination already has a record for the effect ID
the retry payload root differs from the committed payload root
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no external destination implementation is proven

scenarios.trigger: A caller presents a well-shaped receipt root from another effect or destination.
preconditions: the committed effect has a destination record
the presented receipt root is not the canonical receipt for that record
scenarios.fault_boundary: acknowledgment verification before local journal write
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no production receipt bytes or verifier identity is proven

scenarios.trigger: A caller presents an acknowledgment before the destination record exists.
preconditions: the effect is committed but destination delivery has not occurred
the acknowledgment fields may be well-shaped but lack delivery membership
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no local durable journal adapter is proven

scenarios.trigger: A worker loses its lease or becomes unable to complete before lease expiry.
preconditions: the effect remains committed in the outbox
the lease expiry is reached under explicit logical time
scenarios.fault_boundary: lease expiry reclaim before a new worker claim
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no production worker supervision is proven

scenarios.trigger: A worker crashes after leasing and before any destination send.
preconditions: the outbox row is committed and leased
no destination record or receipt exists
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no process supervisor or power-loss behavior is proven

scenarios.trigger: A worker sends successfully, then crashes before local acknowledgment.
preconditions: the destination accepted the committed effect once
the local acknowledgment is absent after the crash
scenarios.fault_boundary: after destination acceptance and before local ack write
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no external exactly-once network claim is made

scenarios.trigger: A worker crashes after the local acknowledgment journal write.
preconditions: the destination accepted the effect
the local acknowledgment is already durable and provenance-bound
scenarios.fault_boundary: after local ack write and before worker response
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
no production journal durability or worker response protocol is proven

scenarios.trigger: The authority epoch changes while a worker holds an older delivery context.
preconditions: the worker context names the previous authority epoch
the migration transition changes the active writer or delivery profile
scenarios.fault_boundary: delivery-use authorization check after migration phase advance
nonclaims: M6 remains unmounted and non-promotable
the real migration authority switch is not implemented

global_nonclaims: the matrix does not prove production datastore durability, network delivery, migration mounting, no-bypass coverage, accounting, backing, or zUSD safety
